name: reform-studio-sync
description: ReformStudioSync — Egystúdiós (SaaS-ready) Recepciós és Valós Idejű Vendégmonitor Rendszer

scripts.build:api: npm --workspace=@reform/shared run build && npm --workspace=@reform/api run build
scripts.build:web: npm --workspace=@reform/shared run build && npm --workspace=@reform/web run build
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build:web && npm --workspace=@reform/web run deploy
scripts.build: npm run build:shared &&npm --workspace=@reform/api run build && npm --workspace=@reform/web run build
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace=@reform/api run test
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace=@reform/api run typecheck && npm --workspace=@reform/web run typecheck
